विलक्षित a. marked, knowable by (instr. or —˚);
puzzled, vexed.

विलङ्घन n. springing over, striking against,
harming, injuring.

विलङ्घ्य a. to be overstepped or passed over (river);
to be borne, tolerable.
विलज्ज a. shameless.
विलज्जित a. ashamed, abashed.
विलपन n. wailing, lamenting.
1 विलापन a. & n. causing to lament.

2 †विलापन f. ई dissolving, melting, removing,
destroying.
विल˚पित n. wailing, lamenting.

विलम्ब a. hanging down;
 n. lagging, loitering.
विलम्बन n. ˚ना f. retarding, delay.
विलम्ब्य ger. lagging, loitering, slowly, so late.
विलय m. dissolution, destruction, disappearance.
विलयन a. dissolving, n. = prec.
विलसन a. coruscating etc. = seq.

विलसित a. shining, radiant, appeared, risen, moving to
and fro, coruscating (lightning), sporting, dallying.
विलाप m. lament.

विलासक f. ˚सिका moving hither and thither, dancing.

विलासवती f. a coquettish woman.
विलासिकत्व n. abstr. to seq. adj.
विलुण्ठन n. plundering, robbing, stealing.
विलुम्पक m. robber, destroyer.

विलुलित a. moved hither and thither, fallen down or
asunder, disordered, confused.
विलेप m. ˚न n. ointment, rubbing in.
विलेपिन् a. smearing, anointing.

विलोकन n. look, glance;
 consideration.

विलो˚कित n. look, glance;
 consideration.

 n. eye.

विलोडन n. stirring up, churning.
विलोप m. loss, disturbance, destruction, injury, theft.

विलोभन n. attraction, seduction.
